## What is missing, and what it costs to be missing

Not what to build yet. What is wrong with the tree as it stands, and who runs
into it.

## What to build

The shape of the thing. Where it lives, what it refuses, and what it leaves
alone.

## Which decision this depends on

Name the file in `docs/decisions/` this rests on, or say that the decision does
not exist yet and what it would have to settle. If it contradicts one, say which
and why the decision should move.

## What it costs

The dependency, the runtime, the compile time, the second code path, or the
thing that now has to be kept in step with something else. A proposal with no
cost section has not been thought about yet.

## Done when

Conditions somebody else can check, one per line. Where a condition is a number,
name the command that will produce it.
